request.prompt: A single low-poly game-ready ruggedised military hexacopter reconnaissance drone, a machine of a fictional army in plain matte olive-drab paint with dark gunmetal fittings, clean and military. At rest, level. Six rotor arms in a ring, each rotor inside a round guard, around a boxy angular central body with a chunky battery pack on top, accessory rails along the sides, a short stubby antenna mast, and a gimballed sensor ball hanging under the nose; ruggedised military build, not a smooth consumer drone. Real-world scale, 0.9 metres across. Matte olive paint, gunmetal fittings, black rotors. Plain even lighting, no baked shadows, no ground, no base, no plinth, centred, one object, facing forward. No insignia, flags, patches, text or markings of any kind.
